ios.desc:
Reflectr: Private AI Notebook & Journal
Your private space for writing, reflection, and smart support.

Reflectr is your personal AI-powered notebook - a secure space to write thoughts, capture ideas, and make sense of your mind with help from intelligent AI companions.

Whether you're jotting notes, organizing ideas, reflecting on your day, or simply thinking out loud - Reflectr gives you calm, clarity, and control.

Why Reflectr?

AI Companions Who Think Differently
Talk to unique AI personalities like the Optimist, Philosopher, Realist, and more. They read your entries and offer helpful insights, questions, or reflections — like having a thoughtful friend for every mood.

100% Private & Secure
Everything stays on your device and is end-to-end encrypted. Lock your notebook with passcode or Face ID. No cloud syncing, no tracking — just real privacy.

Freeform Writing with Smart Support
Write freely and naturally. Use AI suggestions to clean up tone, simplify thoughts, or reword your posts — or just ask questions about what you wrote.

Mood & Insight Tracking
Reflectr automatically detects your mood and themes from each entry, then shows emotional trends over time — no extra effort required.

Smart Organization, Zero Hassle
Notes are automatically categorized into journals, reflections, reminders, goals, and more. Search by tag, theme, or tone with ease.

Built to Think With You
Ask follow-up questions about your past posts, uncover patterns, and deepen your understanding of what matters to you.

Write. Think. Reflect.
Your thoughts aren’t just text — they’re the start of a deeper conversation.
Download Reflectr and start exploring your mind, securely and intelligently.

android.desc:
Simple, interactive, online micro-journal book with AI:

Micro-Journaling: On Reflectr, you can jot down your thoughts super quickly, kind of like posting on social media, but it's all private. It's like having a mini journal diary or a special book just for your thoughts. Using Reflectr makes it easy to write more often and be honest about how you feel. It's the best journal diary notebook for keeping track of your emotions and mood.

AI Integration: The app uses AI in three cool ways. First, AI personalities chat with you, making journaling fun. Second, AI helps sort and organize your entries, so you don't have to do it yourself. Lastly, you can talk to your journal and ask it questions to get better insights. It's like having an online journal diary book with a lock where you can chat with your journal diary every day.

More about the features:

AI personalities: You're not alone in your journaling process. Our personalities will comment on your AI notebook posts and also provide daily and weekly affirmations, recommendations, and motivations. All based on your posts. Choose from AI personalities such as philosopher, optimist, comedian, realist, skeptic, contrarian, analyst, and dreamer.

AI-introspect: Reflectr offers a special diary just for you where you can write about your experiences. It helps you think more about your thoughts and ideas. After you've written for a while, you can look back and ask your diary questions about what you wrote, like what's on your mind or things you're thankful for. It's like having a daily diary for writing—a diary journal app with a lock and you can chat with your journal whenever you want!

AI-assisted writing styles: Just write down your thoughts or talk into the app to record them. You can even choose how you want your writing to look with the help of AI. Reflectr is a private digital space where you can keep your self-care journal online. Don't worry about spelling or making everything perfect—let the AI fix it for you!

AI-based mood calendar: Write down anything you're thinking about, and at the end of each day, the app will show your mood based on what you wrote. You can see your mood trends on the calendar, giving you a full picture of how you feel each day in your private digital space.

quotes.text:
I created Reflectr as a space to freely and privately post your thoughts, ideas, observations, and mental notes without the pressure of social media or sharing, just for yourself.

I wanted to leverage the recent breakthroughs in generative AI and incorporate those capabilities into Reflectr to help generate automated feedback and insights from your posts, such as comments, mood indicators, tags, emojis, daily recaps, and writing tips to help you reflect and be more focused and productive.

I have an exciting roadmap planned with more features and AI-generated insights to help you focus on what brings you joy and boosts your productivity.

It's now available on both the iOS and Android App Stores, links below:
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/reflectr/id6446969075
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.dailylabs.daily_app

I'd love for you to try Reflectr and share your honest feedback! If you have any questions or suggestions, I'm here to answer them!

Thank you,
Sashi.
